entities.name: 5GMM status procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to report error conditions detected upon receipt of 5GMM protocol data in the AMF or UE. The 5GMM STATUS message can be sent by both entities.

entities.name: 5GMM STATUS
entities.description: Message used in the 5GMM status procedure to report error conditions detected in 5GMM protocol data.

entities.name: Error conditions detected
entities.description: Condition where certain error conditions are detected upon receipt of 5GMM protocol data in the AMF or UE.

relations.description: The 5GMM status procedure involves sending the 5GMM STATUS message.
Detection of error conditions triggers the 5GMM status procedure.
The 5GMM STATUS message reports the error conditions detected.
